Calibration bounds for a model structure

Source: R/structures.R
calibration_bounds.Rd

Looks up default calibration bounds for every calibrated parameter of a configuration's components, from the table shipped in inst/calibration-bounds.csv. Every store parameter in the table is included; parameters that are usually fixed (cmin, st, bg, be, td, qc, area and time step) are not. Parameters that span orders of magnitude, such as recharge and groundwater constants, are marked for log-scale search.

Usage

calibration_bounds(config, overrides = NULL, exclude = NULL)

Arguments

config

A configuration list.

overrides

Optional named list of c(lower, upper) pairs by configuration path, such as list(fc = c(0.8, 1.2)), replacing or adding bounds. Naming a parameter that is locked by default, such as fc, unlocks it.

exclude

Optional configuration paths to leave out, holding them at their values.

Value

A data frame with path, lower, upper, scale (linear or log) and note.

Details

Locked parameters. A parameter left out of the bounds is held at its value in the configuration by every automatic calibration: calibrate_project(), compare_structures(), recommend_structure(), pdm_stages() and calibrate_batch() all take their search from here. Lock any parameter with exclude, setting its value in the configuration first.

The rainfall factor fc is locked by default, at the configuration's value (1 in the presets and the model's default). A calibrated factor absorbs errors in the gauge or radar totals of the calibration period, and carries them into operation, where the rainfall may come from different gauges or a different product. Search it only when the rainfall's bias is known and stable, by giving it bounds: overrides = list(fc = c(0.8, 1.2)), or the table's range c(0.6, 1.6). The table's default column marks which parameters are locked in this way.

Examples

calibration_bounds(pdm_presets("standard"))
#>                path lower   upper  scale
#> 1 distribution.cmax 2e+01     800 linear
#> 2    distribution.b 5e-02       2 linear
#> 3       recharge.kg 1e+00    5000    log
#> 4        surface.k1 5e-01      72    log
#> 5        surface.k2 5e-01      72    log
#> 6    groundwater.kb 1e+02 1000000    log
#>                                                    note
#> 1                           Maximum store capacity (mm)
#> 2           Shape: low values give a near-uniform store
#> 3 Recharge time constant (h); spans orders of magnitude
#> 4                  Time constant of the first store (h)
#> 5                 Time constant of the second store (h)
#> 6                                  Cubic store constant
# Search the rainfall factor too
calibration_bounds(pdm_presets("standard"), overrides = list(fc = c(0.8, 1.2)))
#>                path lower   upper  scale
#> 1                fc 8e-01 1.2e+00 linear
#> 2 distribution.cmax 2e+01 8.0e+02 linear
#> 3    distribution.b 5e-02 2.0e+00 linear
#> 4       recharge.kg 1e+00 5.0e+03    log
#> 5        surface.k1 5e-01 7.2e+01    log
#> 6        surface.k2 5e-01 7.2e+01    log
#> 7    groundwater.kb 1e+02 1.0e+06    log
#>                                                                                note
#> 1 Rainfall factor; outside this range question the rain gauge rather than the model
#> 2                                                       Maximum store capacity (mm)
#> 3                                       Shape: low values give a near-uniform store
#> 4                             Recharge time constant (h); spans orders of magnitude
#> 5                                              Time constant of the first store (h)
#> 6                                             Time constant of the second store (h)
#> 7                                                              Cubic store constant
# Lock the store's shape at 0.4
cfg <- pdm_presets("standard")
cfg$distribution$b <- 0.4
calibration_bounds(cfg, exclude = "distribution.b")
#>                path lower   upper  scale
#> 1 distribution.cmax  20.0     800 linear
#> 2       recharge.kg   1.0    5000    log
#> 3        surface.k1   0.5      72    log
#> 4        surface.k2   0.5      72    log
#> 5    groundwater.kb 100.0 1000000    log
#>                                                    note
#> 1                           Maximum store capacity (mm)
#> 2 Recharge time constant (h); spans orders of magnitude
#> 3                  Time constant of the first store (h)
#> 4                 Time constant of the second store (h)
#> 5                                  Cubic store constant
